title: Beit Trust Postgraduate Scholarships
about: Beit Trust postgraduate scholarships for nationals of Malawi, Zambia and Zimbabwe at partner universities in the UK (September 2027 entry) and South Africa (January 2028 entry). Applications close 12 February 2027.
requirements: Nationals of Malawi, Zambia or Zimbabwe only
Applicants must first be accepted by a Beit Trust partner university
UK partner universities for September 2027 entry; South African partner universities for January 2028 entry
